name: Online Identity Bot
tagline: Checks each day what the search engines are exposing about you
description: Once a day it looks for you the way a stranger would, querying the big search engines for your name, phone number, home address and email, then sorts anything newly surfaced into categories and sends back a tally. It only reads and records - it never signs into a removal service or files takedowns itself.
author: Greg
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
